info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Message Analysis API
info.description: The Financial Message Analysis API facilitates the evaluation and processing of financial messages in banking transactions. This API allows businesses to submit financial message data for analysis, providing insights into transaction patterns, anomalies, and compliance checks. Typical consumers include financial institutions and compliance teams looking to enhance their transaction oversight. The results can help drive decision-making and improve risk management strategies within banking operations.

post.summary: Initiate financial message analysis for payments.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create an analysis for financial messages related to payments. By providing the necessary data, users can leverage this feature to evaluate and extract insights from financial transactions efficiently.
